messages:
Zoe Patel: Quick UX thread: legend swatch tiles for dense multi-series charts. Current small swatches are hard to tap and keyboard focus order is messy. Proposal: increase swatch size to 28px, make entire row a toggleable button (press to highlight series), and add a compact details flyout (mini-sparkline + unit) on hover/focus. Thoughts? Evan Brooks: Size increase makes sense. For keyboard: Tab should land on the first swatch, Arrow keys cycle series, Enter toggles visibility, Space or Enter toggles highlight. Announce with SR: \"Series: errors. Highlighted. Press left/right to move\". Maya Singh: Microcopy: keep flyout info minimal: \"errors · 1.2k (24h)\" and SR description: \"errors, 1,200 in last 24 hours. Press H to hide\". Also include a small chevron icon that opens the full series panel. Carlos Ruiz: Outlier handling note: if a series has extreme spikes, show an overflow tile at the end of the legend: \">= X\" with a count badge. Clicking expands a list of top spikes. Don't compress the main color scale. Zoe Patel: Accessibility pattern idea: optional patterned swatches (dotted/striped) users can toggle in settings. For SR, patterns should be described e.g., \"dotted pattern\" appended to label. Evan Brooks: Implementation: avoid creating many DOM nodes for sparkline thumbnails — render them into one canvas sprite or server-side thumbnails. Focusable elements still need unique IDs for aria-describedby. Example ARIA snippet: ```
Errors, 1,200 in last 24 hours. Press left/right to change series.
``` Maya Singh: Smoothing interplay: show a tiny chip on swatch when smoothing is enabled on that series: \"smoothed\". Clicking chip toggles raw markers overlay. SR should announce when raw overlay is enabled. Carlos Ruiz: For touch we should provide 44px min hit target and long-press to open the mini-details. Short tap toggles highlight/visibility. Long press opens the flyout. Zoe Patel: Decision summary: 1) 28px swatches, row buttons with arrow navigation; 2) compact hover/focus flyout with mini-sparkline + unit; 3) overflow tile for outliers with badge + expand; 4) optional patterned swatches and SR descriptions; 5) smoothing chip per-series with toggle for raw markers; 6) touch long-press to open flyout. Evan Brooks: I'll write keyboard interaction spec and aria text patterns. Maya Singh: I'll draft flyout microcopy and provide examples for SR strings. Carlos Ruiz: I'll prototype the overflow tile behavior and the canvas thumbnail approach. Designbot: Pushed figma frame: https://www.figma.com/file/legend-tiles/compact-swatches frame: legend/tiles-v1 :sparkles: Zoe Patel: Thanks all will move to design-implement after specs attached.
